title: Stalks of extension by zero of modules on a ringed space, and the maps between them
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] and $F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an open $W\subseteq X$ with inclusion $j_W$ write $j_{W,!}:\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X|_W)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ for extension by zero, the left adjoint of restriction [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact], and use stalks as in [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. (1) For an $\mathcal O_X|_W$-module $G$ and $x\in X$: if $x\notin W$ then $(j_{W,!}G)_x=0$; if $x\in W$ there is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{X,x}$-modules $G_x\cong(j_{W,!}G)_x$, natural in $G$. (2) For opens $W\subseteq W'\subseteq X$ there is a canonical morphism of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\iota_{W,W'}:j_{W,!}(F|_W)\to j_{W',!}(F|_{W'})$, adjoint to the morphism $F|_W\to(j_{W',!}(F|_{W'}))|_W$ corresponding to the identity of $F|_W$; $\iota_{W,X}$ is the counit $j_{W,!}(F|_W)\to F$ of the adjunction, $\iota_{W,W}$ is the identity, and $\iota_{W',W''}\circ\iota_{W,W'}=\iota_{W,W''}$ for $W\subseteq W'\subseteq W''$. (3) For $x\in W$, under the isomorphisms of (1) with $G=F|_W$ and $G=F|_{W'}$ (and $(F|_{W'})_x=F_x=(F|_W)_x$), the stalk $(\iota_{W,W'})_x$ is the identity of $F_x$.
